newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,732 to dollar for Dec 13 to 15-BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,732 to dollar for Dec 13 to 15-BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 3,732 to the dollar for December 13 to 15.
This reference rate was set on Wednesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for December 12 is 3,687 to the dollar. It was 3,616 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
